critique: The note proves exact alphabet-independent compilers, sharp cell-sum endpoints, sparse witnesses, and Bell(h) state minimality for the explicitly defined existential-support residual; the framing does not promote that state lower bound into a running-time or universal decision-diagram lower bound. The Bell(h) theorem is confined to unrestricted complete-predecessor mechanisms and does not extend to prescribed sparse graphs, factorized exogeneity, cycles, or succinct nested queries. The only demonstrated computational separation is against a deliberately path-retaining numeric-history baseline, while no implementation or benchmark establishes gains over competitive reduced representations on substantive counterfactual-bound problems. These scope and evidence limitations keep the package below flagship significance and constrain its leading-econometrics-journal score despite the complete same-object theorem package.
